envelope.description: Render canonical investigation reviews and preserve approval compatibility

body.title: Render canonical investigation reviews and preserve approval compatibility
body.summary: Update canonical CR rendering and existing completion-evidence readers for versioned investigation records, with deterministic view regeneration. Preserve legacy record, independent review and explicit override behavior; keep new engine activation capability-gated for S6.
acceptanceChecks: Canonical view exposes compact subject/checkpoint/coverage linkage and explicit source mode without raw evidence dumps.
Rendering failure after valid canonical persistence is repairable without a second artifact revision or lost result.
Existing full/degraded records, severity/confidence and human BUILD approval/override semantics remain unchanged.
Unsupported investigation versions/modes refuse explicitly; older strict consumers are not claimed automatically compatible.
No production engine selection, new MCP phases, tracker messaging or user approval performed.

tests.name: Canonical investigation rendering regenerates without another content revision
Legacy records independent approval overrides and unsupported versions retain explicit behavior
